owner_statement: D-P5.7-PLAN-AUTH: I, mayank-admin, authorize planning, read-only repository analysis, and official primary-source research only for P5.7 Quality, Scale, And Final Acceptance. The authorized planning scope includes deterministic generated cross-portal operator journeys across Command Center, GIS Center, Operations camera/live surfaces, Intelligence Center, Investigation Center, Evidence Desk, Admin Center, Security Center, and Platform Operations; end-to-end generated workflow validation; contract, component, integration, compatibility, and browser validation planning; WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility evidence planning; keyboard, focus, screen-reader, contrast, zoom, target-size, reduced-motion, and error-state validation; English, Gujarati, Hindi, long-text, timezone, date, and number-format validation; responsive, laptop, enhanced-workstation, control-room, multi-monitor, mobile, and tablet validation; C1/C10/C50 generated workload methodology; performance-budget planning for interaction latency, long tasks, map idle, query fan-out, memory, bundle size, media admission, and profile downgrade; resilience validation for event gaps, reconnect, API degradation, recovery, session expiry, stale state, conflict, idempotency, ETag, and profile transitions; security validation for CSP, CSRF, XSS, browser storage, telemetry, authorization, department isolation, dependency, SBOM, license, vulnerability, provenance, and reproducible build checks; immutable Phase 0 through P5.6 readiness verification; final evidence package design; release manifest design; limitation and unsupported-claim register; owner decision options; and a bounded P5.7 implementation and start plan. Internet research is limited to official primary technical, security, accessibility, browser, testing, localization, performance, software supply-chain, and standards sources. Local planning documentation, generated/static planning validation, and one local checkpoint commit without push are authorized. This does not authorize product or test implementation, source import, dependency installation or lockfile changes, backend routes or migrations, frontend or browser runtime execution, real providers or network access, cameras or media, Government or private data, real identities, models, datasets, artifacts or inference, operational alerts or actions, containers, Kubernetes execution, deployment, final Phase 5 acceptance, commit beyond the planning checkpoint, push, pull request, merge, release, or other remote Git.
